what_attempt_1_measured: 12 of 16 cells VOID (receipts graphed_rscan_h100/, pod v5wzecr6wnvjp6, torn down GET=404). EVERY void is the G-arm self-pair (g_b/g_a = 0.923-0.964); the D-arm self-pair reads 0.997-1.001 in ALL 16 cells. The voided block is always g_a — the FIRST timed block of each cell. The same signature sits milder in the merged GBH race (g self-pairs 0.971-0.992, longer blocks). gate_up blocks were ~300 ms and still voided, so block length is not the story: the first block after the cell's captures reads a settling ramp that lasts roughly A FULL BLOCK — the same 'settling ~= a full mode' law the e2e driver's ten-drift finding established (PR #89), reproduced at block scale. The instrument failed; the quantity was never read.
